headline: Duke Energy announces equity units offering
summary: Duke Energy Corporation (NYSE: DUK) today announced it plans to sell 35 million equity units in a public offering. Each equity unit will be issued in a stated amount of $50 ($1.75 billion aggregate stated amount) and will initially be in the form of a corporate unit consisting of a contract to purchase Duke Energy common stock in the future and two 1/40 undivided beneficial ownership interests in Duke Energy's remarketable senior notes, each having a principal amount of $1,000.
